seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: How The CaneHouse in Sutton, London collects, uses and protects your personal information when you contact us, order or book an event.

blocks.heading: Who we are
text: The CaneHouse is a fresh sugarcane juice business based in Sutton, London, United Kingdom. Contact: thecanehouseuk@gmail.com, +44 777 046 1939.

blocks.heading: What we collect
text: When you send an enquiry, booking or franchise application we collect the details you give us:
list: Event or order details and your message

blocks.heading: How we use it
list: To reply to your enquiry and arrange orders, deliveries and events
To send quotes, confirmations and invoices
text: We never sell your details. We only share them with services that help us run the business (for example our email and form providers).

blocks.heading: How long we keep it
text: We keep enquiry details for up to 24 months, or longer where the law requires (for example accounting records).

blocks.heading: Your rights
text: Under UK GDPR you can ask to see, correct or delete your personal data, or object to how we use it. Email us and we will respond within one month. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).

blocks.heading: Cookies
text: This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies. See our Cookie Policy (/cookie-policy) for exactly what is stored on your device.
